name: a lesson page drifts past with a floating preview card
looks: A course lesson page sits slightly out of focus in the background: a breadcrumb trail, a lesson heading and a paragraph of instructions. In front of it, a single preview card holds a short title and a small action icon, catching the eye while the page behind it slowly drifts.
build: A slow camera dolly or parallax scale over the static document layer supplies the sense of motion even though the text itself doesn't change; the foreground card sits on its own layer, slightly offset in depth, staying sharp while the background page stays soft.
sound: A soft whoosh under the camera drift, with a quiet ambient bed.
prompt: Let a document or lesson page sit softly out of focus in the background while the camera drifts slowly across it, and keep one small preview card sharp in front, holding a short title and an action icon, so the page reads as context and the card reads as the thing to notice.
